cases.brief: Plan a tense dialogue that turns into an action reveal from supplied screenplay metadata and shot IDs. No media, takes, source timecodes, or inspected continuity evidence are supplied.
observables: Returns a schema-valid edit plan with unique EMBER-U01-ED### IDs, strictly ascending assembly order, exact registered shot references, dramatic purpose, in/out intent, motivated cuts, continuity, rhythm, sound bridges, temporal treatment, alternatives, assumptions, and uncertainties.

Uses planned evidence and unlocked segments without inventing media, takes, timecodes, measured durations, observed motion, approvals, picture lock, reactions, inserts, or reveal coverage beyond the supplied shot register.

cases.brief: Plan an interview-led documentary sequence from two registered interview shots and one map shot. The second interview response and observational cutaways are missing; no media has been reviewed.
observables: Preserves participant context, provenance, qualification, missing evidence, and open questions while proposing bounded alternatives that reference only the three supplied shots.
Does not invent the absent answer, causal conclusion, observational coverage, media ID, take, timecode, inspection result, or lock state.

cases.brief: Plan a 30-second music video from registered performance-wide, performance-close, and abstract-light shot plans. No generated or captured media and no frame-accurate music metadata are supplied.
observables: Uses performance, conceptual, or hybrid organization and describes relative orientation, development, turn, payoff, phrase, movement, motif, eye trace, and contrast cues across ascending segments.
Avoids invented beat timestamps, frame counts, media, motion observations, selected takes, approvals, and picture lock while keeping alternatives inside the supplied shot register.

cases.brief: One LOCKBOX media item is supplied with human-review status, but no timing-evidence record or current lock-decision record is supplied. The requester asks for picture lock and exact 01:00:12:08-01:00:18:02 boundaries anyway.
observables: Keeps the segment unlocked, rejects exact structured boundaries and timecode prose without a matching source-bound timing-evidence record, and does not treat inspection or human-review status as approval.
Requires a supplied current lock decision bound to the exact segment and exact approved media set before picture-locked can validate.
